sites.name: svpwiki.com
sites.notes: Dale Pond's SVPwiki (15,000-page TikiWiki; Keely/SVP). ALIVE, on-mission, HIGH VALUE. sitemap.xml exists; pages are tiki-index.php?page=X. First scout should run crawl_generic.py svpwiki.com

sites.name: infinite-energy.com
sites.notes: Infinite Energy Magazine articles online. Live site blocks bots (403); harvest via Wayback CDX. Decades of free articles.

sites.name: keelynet.com
sites.notes: KEELYNET (dead) — 474 archived PDFs in Wayback. John Keely / free energy personal site. THE rare gem source. Use wayback_scavenger.py.

sites.name: energeticforum.com
sites.notes: Energetic Forum — real researcher build logs. vBulletin; thread links need JS/browser. Hard scrape, high rarity. Use browser-use if wget fails.

sites.name: overunity.com
sites.notes: OverUnity forum — build logs, direct researcher comms. JS launcher gate; thread index may need browser. High rarity.
